closures.defect: Legacy HR routes and inventory did not match the exact 19-page contract
closures.root_cause: Pre-UI-07 consolidated paths survived into the HR host
closures.resolution: Canonical 15-route tree, eight guarded compatibility redirects and four explicit no-route gates

closures.defect: Staff detail loaded a whole collection before selecting one member
closures.root_cause: Store lacked a direct scoped show operation
closures.resolution: Direct GET /staff/{staff}, server-side roster filters and pagination

closures.defect: Lifecycle reasons were accepted by controller-local validation
closures.root_cause: Mutation reused an overly broad request seam
closures.resolution: Dedicated StaffLifecycleRequest plus typed subject confirmation in the canonical page

closures.defect: Dashboard and audit destinations had no truthful HR presentation reads
closures.root_cause: Existing data was fragmented and raw Audit-account access is forbidden
closures.resolution: Three narrow same-branch read endpoints and HrWorkspaceReadModel; no new mutation or raw audit export

closures.root_cause: Inactive mutation contracts and closed Phase 21N/Gate W dependencies
closures.resolution: Four visible inert entries with no route, component or network runtime

closures.defect: Legacy compensation tests treated a staff detail link as inline plan history
closures.root_cause: UI-11 split detail and append-only history into two canonical pages
closures.resolution: Navigate semantically through Review change history and expose stable history-event landmarks

closures.defect: Missing payout permission redirected to the public landing instead of showing a safe denial
closures.root_cause: A client route guard pre-empted the page's existing forbidden state
closures.resolution: Remove the UX guard; backend authorization remains authoritative and the page renders the safe forbidden state

closures.defect: Theme reload test was overwritten by per-document initialization
closures.root_cause: The harness reapplied the requested initial theme after user preference changed
closures.resolution: Session-scoped initialization marker preserves user choice across reload while keeping each case explicit

closures.defect: Dashboard text contrast guard could not prove white text over a CSS gradient
closures.root_cause: Deterministic contrast analysis cannot model the composite gradient
closures.resolution: Use the approved solid deep-brand field with equivalent hierarchy and provable contrast

closures.defect: Whole-product browser specs rewrote frozen historical evidence
closures.root_cause: Historical evidence specs emit current-run captures by design
closures.resolution: Pre-run hash baseline, exact-path restoration and post-run byte-for-byte checksum verification; current UI-07/UI-11 projections preserved

closures.defect: Exact-head CI run 31727621418 failed Frontend at the UI-06 generated-artifact check
closures.root_cause: Historical cleanup restored docs/frontend/audits/ui-06/public-route-matrix.json even though that one path is a current projection of the router; UI-11 changed the HR route tree
closures.resolution: Regenerate the UI-06 artifacts, retain only the one changed current route matrix, and rerun its deterministic checker plus UI-10/UI-11 consumers before a new exact-head CI run
